articles.title: Soundbar com melhor custo-benefício: 7 modelos abaixo de R$ 2.000 em 2026
articles.text:
Soundbar com melhor custo-benefício: 7 modelos abaixo de R$ 2.000 em 2026
Encontre modelos de soundbar com o melhor preço para melhorar o som da TV sem gastar muito; lista reúne modelos Samsung, LG, TCL e JBL
Uma soundbar pode deixar os diálogos mais claros e dar mais impacto ao som de filmes, séries e jogos. Por menos de R$ 2.000, é possível encontrar desde barras estéreo que cabem em móveis pequenos até conjuntos com subwoofer sem fio, caixas traseiras ou Dolby Atmos.
A escolha depende do que você quer melhorar no som da TV. Um modo de realce de voz pode ajudar a acompanhar as falas em séries, enquanto um subwoofer dedicado reforça os graves e caixas traseiras reproduzem efeitos atrás do sofá.
O Tecnoblog reuniu sete modelos com bom custo-benefício em 2026. Confira os prós e contras.
A JBL Cinema SB595 é uma opção de soundbar com Dolby Atmos e que reúne três canais frontais: um subwoofer externo e dois alto-falantes. Eles projetam o som em direção ao teto para criar a sensação de que certos efeitos vêm de cima.
A JBL informa 220 W de potência total, com 100 W na barra e 120 W no subwoofer sem fio de 6,5 polegadas. O modelo também tem um canal central dedicado, que costuma concentrar boa parte dos diálogos em trilhas multicanal, conforme a mixagem.
O conjunto dispensa caixas traseiras, o que simplifica a instalação, mas limita a reprodução de sons vindos de trás de quem assiste. A conectividade inclui uma saída HDMI eARC, uma entrada HDMI adicional, entrada óptica e Bluetooth 5.4.
Com 1 metro de largura, a SB595 exige espaço no móvel e acompanha um kit de montagem na parede.
A LG S60TR é indicada para quem quer ouvir efeitos sonoros vindos de trás ao assistir a filmes e séries. O sistema 5.1 reúne uma barra com canal central, um subwoofer e duas caixas traseiras incluídas. Posicionadas atrás da área de escuta, essas caixas reproduzem os canais surround de trilhas multicanal.
Com 440 W RMS de potência total, o modelo aceita Dolby Digital e DTS Digital Surround e traz o AI Sound Pro, que ajusta o processamento conforme o conteúdo. Também há modos específicos para cinema, música, jogos e esportes.
A barra tem HDMI ARC, entrada óptica e Bluetooth 5.3. Em TVs LG compatíveis, o WOW Interface permite trocar modos de som e acessar outros ajustes pela tela da televisão.
As caixas traseiras recebem o sinal da barra sem fio, mas são ligadas entre si por um cabo, e uma delas precisa de tomada — assim como o subwoofer.
A LG S40T é uma opção da marca para quem quer um subwoofer sem instalar caixas pela sala. O sistema 2.1 tem dois canais frontais e um subwoofer externo sem fio. A barra mede 72 cm de largura, o que facilita a instalação em móveis menores.
A potência total é de 300 W RMS e a barra aceita Dolby Digital e DTS Digital Surround para uma experiência de som mais aprimorada. O AI Sound Pro ajusta o processamento conforme o conteúdo, e o usuário também pode selecionar modos como Cinema e Jogo.
Entre as conexões estão HDMI ARC, entrada óptica, Bluetooth 5.3 e USB para reprodução de áudio. O WOW Interface permite fazer ajustes pela tela de TVs LG compatíveis e o aplicativo LG ThinQ também oferece controles pelo celular.
A TCL S55H é voltada a quem quer efeitos de som espacial com poucos equipamentos. Ela combina dois canais frontais e um subwoofer sem fio em um sistema 2.1 de 220 W, com suporte a Dolby Atmos e DTS Virtual:X.
Segundo a marca, a barra ajusta o reforço dos graves conforme o volume, com a proposta de mantê-los mais presentes em volumes baixos e mais controlados em volumes altos. O modelo tem 81 cm de largura e também oferece modos de som para diferentes conteúdos e calibração acústica pelo aplicativo TCL Home.
Para conectar a barra à TV, a TCL oferece HDMI eARC, além de Bluetooth 5.4. O modelo também conta com recurso que permite usar a barra e os alto-falantes da televisão ao mesmo tempo em TVs TCL compatíveis. A disponibilidade, no entanto, depende do modelo da TV.
A JBL Cinema SB180 reúne dois canais frontais e um subwoofer sem fio de 6,5 polegadas. A JBL declara 110 W RMS de potência total, divididos entre 50 W na barra e 60 W no subwoofer.
Os modos Cinema, Música e Notícias permitem ajustar o processamento ao conteúdo. Como a barra tem dois canais frontais, os diálogos são reproduzidos por eles, enquanto o subwoofer tem a função de reproduzir as frequências graves.
A conexão com a TV pode ser feita por HDMI ARC ou entrada óptica, o Bluetooth 5.3 permite transmitir áudio do celular, e a porta USB reproduz arquivos MP3. A barra tem 92 cm de largura, um detalhe a considerar em móveis menores.
A Samsung HW-B400F é uma soundbar de entrada para quem tem pouco espaço no móvel. O sistema 2.0 reúne quatro alto-falantes distribuídos em dois canais e um woofer integrado. A própria barra reproduz os graves, o que dispensa uma caixa separada.
O modo de realce de voz dá ênfase aos diálogos, enquanto o Surround Sound Expansion usa processamento para ampliar a percepção espacial do áudio. A barra também oferece o modo Padrão e um Modo Noturno, que reduz os graves e o volume para uso à noite.
Com 64,1 cm de largura, a barra tem HDMI ARC, entrada óptica, USB para reprodução de músicas e Bluetooth 4.2. O controle remoto de TVs Samsung compatíveis pode operar funções como volume e efeitos sonoros.
A porta HDMI é destinada ao retorno de áudio da TV, mas sem uma entrada adicional para ligar um console ou outro aparelho diretamente à barra.
A Philips TAB4000/78 é uma alternativa para quem quer substituir o áudio integrado da TV por uma barra estéreo com poucos componentes. O sistema 2.0 tem dois canais frontais e dispensa subwoofer externo. A barra mede 76 cm de largura.
A Philips informa 60 W de potência máxima, com reprodução estéreo — os diálogos são distribuídos pelos canais esquerdo e direito. A configuração é voltada ao uso cotidiano com filmes, séries e programas de TV.
A conexão HDMI ARC recebe áudio PCM estéreo de televisores compatíveis. A barra também tem Bluetooth 5.4 para transmitir áudio do celular e uma porta USB para reproduzir arquivos MP3, WAV e FLAC.
A escolha pela melhor soundbar custo-benefício deve considerar o tamanho da sala, as conexões da TV e o tipo de conteúdo que você mais assiste. Vale conferir os seguintes aspectos antes de comprar.
Na soundbar com graves integrados, os alto-falantes responsáveis pelas frequências mais baixas ficam na própria barra, o que economiza espaço.
O subwoofer dedicado usa uma caixa separada e tende a dar mais profundidade e impacto a cenas de ação e músicas. Mesmo quando recebe o áudio sem fio, ele precisa de tomada.
A potência necessária depende do tamanho da sala, da distância até o sofá e do volume em que você costuma assistir à TV. Para uma sala pequena, uma barra compacta pode atender bem em volume moderado.
Em ambientes maiores, vale observar se ela mantém os diálogos claros no volume desejado, já que os watts RMS, sozinhos, não indicam quão alto ou limpo será o som.
Escolha uma 2.0 se você quer uma instalação compacta para assistir à TV no dia a dia. A 2.1 faz mais sentido se você procura mais impacto nos graves.
Já a 5.1 com caixas traseiras é indicada para ouvir efeitos vindos de trás em filmes, séries e jogos com áudio multicanal compatível.
Sim, especialmente se o som da TV parece abafado ou se você tem dificuldade para entender os diálogos. Uma barra estéreo com realce de voz e HDMI ARC pode atender bem a esse uso.
Se a prioridade for sentir o impacto de explosões ou ouvir efeitos atrás do sofá, vale investir em um modelo com subwoofer dedicado ou caixas traseiras, conforme o efeito que você deseja.
Sim. Para ouvir diálogos com mais clareza ou dar mais impacto aos graves, um canal central ou um subwoofer podem fazer mais diferença no dia a dia.
O Dolby Atmos vale a atenção de quem costuma assistir a conteúdos compatíveis e quer ter mais efeitos de imersão em filmes e séries.
Sim, se a ideia é melhorar o som da TV com poucos equipamentos. Para reproduzir efeitos atrás do sofá com separação física, procure um conjunto com caixas traseiras.
Uma barra estéreo sozinha concentra a reprodução sorona na frente, mesmo quando oferece surround virtual.

articles.title: Vulnerability could let hacker hijack electric trailer braking system remotely via Bluetooth, apply any amount of force remotely — Elecbrakes flaw reverse-engineered using Claude, patched by manufacturer
articles.text:
Vulnerability could let hacker hijack electric trailer braking system remotely via Bluetooth, apply any amount of force remotely — Elecbrakes flaw reverse-engineered using Claude, patched by manufacturer
Thankfully, there were no reported incidents of this vulnerability causing damage or injury before it was patched.
After noticing that his Elecbrakes remote had automatically paired to a stranger's trailer, Patrick Forck's cybersecurity spider senses tingled. Any feelings of foreboding were warranted, as it was discovered that a critical Bluetooth security flaw meant anyone could connect to an Elecbrakes controller "without pairing, authentication, a PIN, or any approval." Over the following 10 months, Forck and his Element Digital colleague Jeremy McCarthy would fully identify the vulnerabilities, make responsible disclosures to the vendor, work on fix verification, and more.
The story goes that Forck was a contented user of the Elecbrakes solution for the trailer towing fraternity. The firm's systems are claimed to be easy DIY plug-and-play controllers for enhanced braking response – important for trailer towing, especially with larger and heavier loads. The core functionality wasn't a problem, but Forck was alarmed when driving down the highway one day and noticed that his Elecbrakes In-Car Remote had connected to someone else’s trailer. "It had connected mid-drive, without pairing or a prompt, to a brake controller that wasn’t mine, on a trailer I’d never seen, belonging to a driver who had no idea," explained our tech-savvy protagonist. It wasn't long before he thought, "If a device I don’t own will happily talk to my in-car remote driving past with zero friction… what exactly is stopping my phone or any other Bluetooth device from talking back?" Clearly, Elecbrakes ' ease of use was unintentionally too powerful.
Forck and McCarthy's first step on the road to a solution was to use Claude to do the heavy lifting on the reverse engineering of the Elecbrakes Android app. McCarthy built a Web Bluetooth research tool that runs in Chrome, again using Claude. Then Forck tested the newly built tool with his car and trailer on some gravel roads on his family estate. It was confirmed that any attacker could connect via Bluetooth from nearby without Bluetooth pairing or authentication. Moreover, they could send simple commands to the trailer, apply braking at any force level, and receive confirmation that the brake had engaged.
As per the blog post documenting the finding and fixing of these vulnerabilities, the danger of a security flaw which "outputs torque to a wheel on a public road," is difficult to overstate. Especially when the attack surface and opportunity are open to “anyone within Bluetooth range.”
With the bulk of research complete, the Element Digital colleagues disclosed the information to Elecbrakes in May 2026. They were pleased with the small firm's responsiveness and openness. By July, firmware updates to patch the EB2 and VM1 models currently on the market were released.
An older Elecbrakes controller called the ELBC 2000 was discovered to have the same Bluetooth security flaws. The vulnerability of this model, which hasn't been sold for a number of years, has now been confirmed by the maker. Nevertheless, some folks will be using it on public roads. Elecbrakes has advised owners to keep an eye on firmware update notices for an impending fix.

articles.title: XERON Launches Upgraded C LAB Chassis
articles.text:
Tuesday, November 24th 2026
XERON Launches Upgraded C LAB Chassis
XERON, a PC hardware brand guided by its "From Origin, Beyond Boundaries" philosophy, has officially launched the C LAB. Engineered to elevate the personal computer into a striking desktop centerpiece, this mid-tower ATX chassis merges a distinctive C-shaped floating frame design with an expansive, full-view tempered glass side panel to showcase internal hardware and RGB lighting in high definition.
Built around a hybrid aluminium and steel structure, the XERON C LAB features a 4 mm-thick aluminium outer exoskeleton wrapping a rigid SGCC steel body. Its precision one-piece sheet metal construction eliminates the uneven seams and alignment inconsistencies common in multi-panel builds, delivering a clean, seamless aesthetic. Complementing its structural refinement, the semi-open chassis incorporates independent cooling zones for the CPU, GPU, and power supply, along with extensive mounting support for up to ten 120 mm fans and dual 360 mm radiators to deliver exceptional thermal performance.Key Features
- C-Shaped Floating Wrap Design: Distinctive aluminium frame with rounded, minimalist styling.
- aluminium Alloy Exoskeleton: 4 mm aluminium outer frame paired with a cold-rolled steel body.
- One-Piece Formed Sheet Metal: Manufactured using NCT processing for Precision Fit & Finish.
- Full-View Tempered Glass: 4 mm tempered glass side panel showcases internal components and lighting.
- Independent Cooling: Separate airflow zones for the CPU, GPU, and PSU.
- Extensive Cooling Support: Accommodates up to ten 120 mm fans and 360 mm radiators at the top and front.
- Back-Connect Motherboard Support: Supports compatible back-connect motherboard designs for cleaner cable management.
- Modern Connectivity: Front I/O includes a 20 Gbps USB Type-C port, two USB 3.0 ports, and an audio connection.
Architectural Craftsmanship & Ergonomics
The XERON C LAB blends structural durability with refined design. Its 4 mm aluminium exoskeleton provides rigid strength over a SGCC steel base, while NCT-machined sheet metal ensures smooth, uniform panel alignment. Designed for modern build aesthetics, full support for back-connect motherboards allows all primary cables to route behind the tray, leaving the main chamber clear and visible through the tempered glass side panel.
Multi-Zone Thermal Engineering
To maintain optimal thermal dynamics within a semi-open design, the XERON C LAB implements isolated cooling zones for the CPU, GPU, and power supply. Combined with multiple intake channels and a heavily vented rear panel, the chassis accommodates up to ten 120 mm fans and dual 360 mm radiators (top and front simultaneously) to comfortably cool high-draw components.
Hardware Compatibility and Connectivity
Built for broad component support, the XERON C LAB accommodates ATX, microATX, and Mini-ITX motherboards—including back-connect designs—along with seven PCIe expansion slots and ATX power supplies up to 160 mm. It supports CPU coolers up to 165 mm tall and GPUs up to 425 mm long, scaling down to 400 mm with standard front fans or 370 mm with a 30 mm front radiator. The front I/O provides high-speed 20 Gbps USB-C, dual USB 3.0 ports, 3.5 mm audio, and power.Pricing and Availability
The XERON C LAB Mid-Tower Chassis will be available in Black and White, with both variants priced at US$249. It is expected to reach partner resellers in Q1 2027.
For more information, visit the product page.

articles.title: Criptomonedas: el valor de Bitcoin para este día
articles.text:
El bitcoin fue la primera criptomoneda que salió al mercado. Ideada por Satoshi Nakamoto en 2008, esta divisa digital promovía un ideal libertario y buscaba poner en jaque a las instituciones monetarias y financieras tradicionales luego de la crisis financiera mundial que se vivió ese año.
La victoria electoral de Donald Trump significó un movimiento positivo para las principales criptomonedas del mercado. A finales de 2024, bitcoin registró un nuevo máximo histórico que logró superar los 107.000 dólares por unidad, después de que el presidente estadounidense reiteró su idea de crear una reserva estratégica de la criptodivisa en Estados Unidos.
Las divisas digitales serán un foco de atención durante este año, las iniciativas del presidente de Estados Unidos y el desarrollo de nuevos modelos de inteligencia artificial fungirán un papel importante en la cotización de estos activos. Después del lanzamiento del nuevo modelo de IA chino DeepSeek, BTC y otras criptos cayeron en la mayoría de los mercados de valores.
Costo de la criptomoneda Bitcoin
El valor de la criptomoneda de bitcoin para este día a las 14:00 horas (UTC) es de 60044.79 dólares por unidad.
Esto quiere decir que el activo digital anotó un cambio del -1.86% en las últimas 24 horas, así como una variación del 0.0% en la última hora.
Actualmente, bitcoin se encuentra en el lugar #1 de popularidad en el mercado digital. Cabe mencionar que el máximo histórico que ha alcanzado esta moneda digital es de 126.198 dólares por unidad.
Bitcoin alcanza un nuevo récord y lidera el auge en el mercado de las criptomonedas
En marzo del año pasado el bitcoin ha logrado un nuevo máximo histórico, superando los valores anteriores y reafirmándose como la criptomoneda más importante en el mercado, acercándose a los 73 mil dólares. Este récord se obtuvo en medio de un flujo sin precedentes de inversiones hacia las criptomonedas, un acontecimiento notable para el sector financiero digital.
El aumento en el valor de bitcoin ocurre en un contexto donde hay un entrante masivo de capital hacia las criptomonedas, lo que indica un creciente interés y confianza de los inversores en estos activos. La subida del precio beneficia no solo a bitcoin sino que también tiene un impacto positivo en el mercado de las criptomonedas en general, favoreciendo una mayor estabilidad y visibilidad, de acuerdo a un análisis de Bloomberg.
Expertos financiaron este aumento a diferentes factores, como la adopción institucional de las criptomonedas, la búsqueda de alternativas de inversión debido a la incertidumbre económica mundial y la innovación continua en la tecnología blockchain que respalda a bitcoin y otras divisas digitales. Esta combinación de factores ha creado un entorno propicio para el crecimiento continuo en el valor de Bitcoin.
Cómo adquirir criptomonedas
Para comprarlas e intercambiarlas se utilizan portales especializados. Su valor varía en función de la oferta, de la demanda y del compromiso de los usuarios, por lo que puede cambiar más rápido que el dinero tradicional, pero mientras más gente esté interesada y quiera comprar determinada divisa, mayor será su valor.
No obstante, quien invierte en este tipo de monedas digitales debe tener muy claro que esta forma trae consigo un elevado riesgo al capital, pues, así como puede haber un incremento, también puede tener inesperadamente un desplome y acabar con los ahorros de sus usuarios.
Para almacenarlas, los usuarios deben contar con un monedero digital o wallet, que en realidad es un software a través del cual es posible guardar, enviar y hacer transacciones de las criptomonedas. En realidad, este tipo de monederos sólo guarda las claves que marcan la propiedad y el derecho de una persona sobre cierta criptomoneda, por lo que estos códigos son los que en realidad se deben proteger.

articles.title: Half of NASA's aging Mars fleet knocked offline by technical issues
articles.text:
Two of NASA’s four missions operating at Mars have suspended science operations after encountering separate technical issues in recent weeks.
The missions affected by the outages—hopefully temporary—are NASA’s Perseverance rover and Odyssey orbiter. Both are operating beyond their original design lifetimes. Perseverance is in its sixth year exploring the surface of Mars, having collected rock and soil samples for eventual return to Earth. The rover is now studying the rim of a crater that once contained an ancient lake of liquid water. Odyssey arrived in orbit around Mars in 2001, and is the longest-lived Mars mission in history.
Losing its voice
The problem on Perseverance stems from the rover’s communications system. The rover has two redundant UHF radios for high-rate communications with a fleet of orbiters that relay data to Earth. A separate X-band system is available for direct-to-Earth communications at a lower data rate.
One of the rover’s two UHF radios was unresponsive when it powered up on October 30, triggering an automatic switch to the backup radio and placing the rover in safe mode. Ground teams at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in California later discovered the backup UHF radio was transmitting at about half of its expected power output, NASA said in a statement last week.
“The team has stopped using both radios until they can evaluate potential causes of the issues and one or both are deemed safe to resume operating,” NASA said.
Perseverance is now transmitting signals directly to Earth in X-band, but the connection provides a “significantly lower data rate” than relaying signals through orbiters using the UHF radios. Mission managers paused the rover’s science operations “out of an abundance of caution” as they investigate the radio problem. Their initial focus is on getting the backup UHF radio running before turning their attention on recovering the primary radio, NASA said.

articles.title: Fitbit Air gets unofficial phone notifications — third-party Android app unlocks custom haptic alerts and I've tried it
articles.text:
New Fitbit Air app hacks the Google tracker to add its biggest missing feature — notifications from your phone
Meet the Fitbit Air Notifier
- Fitbit Air Notifier brings notification alerts to the Fitbit Air
- You can customize the alerts by app or by contact
- The app has already found fans who wanted the functionality
For some, the appeal of the Google Fitbit Air is its simplicity: no screen, one LED light, and vibrations that are restricted to alarms and nothing else. For others, that's not enough — and a third-party app now enables phone notifications to buzz the wearable, too.
It's called Fitbit Air Notifier (via 9to5Google), and it's free to install and use. You can set vibrations per app, or per contact, so only the events that matter to you most will send an alert to your wrist and get you to check your phone.
The usual rules about apps apply here, in that you install them at your own risk — especially when they are unofficial companion apps for hardware — but Fitbit Air Notifier promises not to share any of your data or indeed collect any data at all.
I gave the app a go with my own Fitbit Air, and I was up and running inside a minute. There's an impressive amount of customization on offer here, letting you change everything from the vibration strength to the notification keywords to alert for.
Another app choice
A couple of other features worth mentioning are the Quiet Hours filter, during which notifications won't come through, and the Find my Air feature that uses vibrations and Bluetooth signal strength to help you track down a lost wearable.
The app gives you enough control over the wrist buzzes that you can have your Fitbit Air alert you to really important notifications without being overloaded with alerts — which is one of the reasons to choose this tracker over one with a screen.
Fitbit Air Notifier isn't the only new app to do this either, because there's another called Cuff that optionally incorporates health stats as well, if you don't want to use Google Health for the job. For the time being though, Cuff requires sideloading.

articles.title: Si eres estudiante pagas menos: así es la oferta que deja el Google Pixel 11 por 598 euros
articles.text:
Si has estado esperando el Black Friday para renovar el móvil, hay una buena selección de ofertas. De hecho, tenemos algunas de las mejores hasta la fecha. Es lo que ocurre con el Google Pixel 11, que ahora mismo se puede comprar por 598,35 euros. ¿Cómo acceder a la oferta? Vamos a explicarlo.
Google Pixel 11 (256 GB)

articles.title: Zipher lands $53M to put AI agents, not data engineers, in charge of data workloads
articles.text:
Zipher lands $53M to put AI agents, not data engineers, in charge of data workloads
Data infrastructure startup Zipher Technologies Ltd. today announced that it has raised $53 million in funding for a platform where artificial intelligence agents, not data engineers, decide how enterprise data workloads run.
Founded in 2024, Zipher takes over the day-to-day running of enterprise data workloads, from resource allocation to framework selection and scheduling. Customers set performance targets and budgets, leaving the rest to the company’s agents. The platform runs on Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, with support for data tools including Databricks Workflows, Apache Airflow, dbt and Azure Data Factory.
The company already manages production workloads for a number of Fortune 500 enterprises in sectors including financial services, travel, consumer packaged goods and energy. Those customers see cost-efficiency gains of 40% to 60%, it says, with service-level agreement adherence improving by as much as 80%.
Among them is Hertz Global Holdings Inc. Gaurav Rastogi, senior director of enterprise data analytics and BI platforms at Hertz, said the car rental company has seen compute cost reductions of 25% to 40% depending on the workload while “supporting consistent performance through seasonal peaks.”
Behind the numbers is an argument that AI agents have changed the way enterprises use their data platforms, with anyone in an organization now able to spin up a data workload in seconds. Zipher’s agents learn each of those workloads, dependencies included, and then pick the engine each one runs on based on capacity and load at the time.
The agents can go as far as rewriting a workload’s framework, code and syntax. Dan Coster, Zipher’s co-founder and chief executive, said that as agents create more workloads, the infrastructure needs to “make its own decisions.”
The funding is intended to support research and development along with go-to-market work. Zipher plans to build out its U.S. enterprise sales team and expand across Latin America, Asia-Pacific and the Europe, Middle East and Africa region.
Zipher was founded by Coster and Chief Technology Officer Yoav Gill Ben Ephraim, both alumni of Unit 8200, the Israel Defense Forces’ intelligence technology unit. Ben Ephraim previously served as director of data platform at Payoneer Global Inc. and held a senior data role at Microsoft Corp. The company is headquartered in New York, with offices in Tel Aviv.
The $53 million, which covers both Zipher’s seed and Series A rounds, came from TLV Partners, Maor Investments and Glilot Capital Partners. Angel investors and advisers include Dremio Corp. co-founder Tomer Shiran, Monte Carlo AI Inc. co-founders Barr Moses and Lior Gavish and Cribl Inc. co-founder Clint Sharp.
According to TLV Partners Managing Partner Shahar Tzafrir, enterprises in an agentic world need a platform that decides where and how each workload runs. The Zipher team, he added, has “proven it in production with Fortune 500 customers who keep expanding their use of the platform.”

articles.title: Le Black Friday au service des têtes en l’air : l’Apple AirTag de deuxième génération passe à 25€ chez Amazon
articles.text:
Bien pratique pour retrouver des affaires égarées ou pour suivre une valise à la trace, l’AirTag de deuxième génération est actuellement disponible pour 25 € au lieu de 35 € chez Amazon à l’occasion du Black Friday.
Vous possédez un iPhone et vous avez tendance à chercher votre trousseau de clés ou votre sac à main trois fois par semaine ? C’est le signe qu’il faut vous équiper d’un AirTag… Voire de plusieurs. En ce moment chez Amazon, l’Apple AirTag de deuxième génération coûte 25 €.
Ce petit accessoire permet d’associer un objet à l’application Localiser d’iOS, afin de le retrouver plus facilement en cas de perte. Il est important de noter que cette balise s’adresse exclusivement aux utilisateurs de l’écosystème Apple.
L’Apple AirTag de deuxième génération est à 25 € chez Amazon, soit 10 € de moins que son tarif Apple de 35 €.
Pourquoi choisir l’AirTag de deuxième génération ?
- Pour retrouver vos affaires à proximité : le haut-parleur intégré permet de faire sonner la balise lorsqu’un objet se cache dans la maison.
- Pour le réseau Localiser : les appareils Apple passant près de l’AirTag peuvent relayer sa position même lorsqu’il n’est pas à portée de votre propre iPhone.
- Pour sa pile remplaçable : une pile bouton CR2032 assure plus d’un an d’autonomie, sans besoin de recharge régulière.
Une aide pour les petits oublis du quotidien
Glissé dans une poche de sac ou fixé à un trousseau avec un accessoire adapté, l’AirTag peut être consulté directement au sein de l’app Localiser présente sur l’iPhone. Il ne faut que quelques instants pour le configurer. Ensuite, il y a deux cas de figure : soit l’AirTag est situé à proximité de votre position, et, dans ce cas, la fonction Localisation précise vous guide vers l’objet associé si votre iPhone est compatible. Soit il n’est pas à portée, mais les iPhone d’autres utilisateurs le captent : vous pouvez donc quand même savoir où il se trouve.
Cette deuxième génération améliore notamment la portée et le volume sonore, deux progrès évoqués dans notre test de l’AirTag 2, qui lui a donné la note de 8 sur 10.
Un réseau étendu, mais pas un suivi permanent
L’AirTag 2 s’utilise sans abonnement à payer, et il est parfaitement intégré à l’écosystème d’Apple. En revanche, la remontée de sa position à distance dépend des appareils Apple qui passent à proximité : si votre objet est perdu dans un endroit où personne ne circule, il est malheureusement possible que vous ne sachiez pas où il se trouve précisément.
✅ Les points forts
- Intégration à l’application Localiser.
- Haut-parleur et portée améliorés.
- Pile CR2032 remplaçable par l’utilisateur.
❌ Les limites
- Configuration réservée aux appareils Apple compatibles.
- Accessoire de fixation à acheter séparément pour les clés.
Pour équiper un sac, une valise ou un trousseau de clés, l’AirTag d’Apple est utile, surtout à 25 € pendant le Black Friday Amazon.
L’AirTag 2 a tout pour devenir indispensable aux utilisateurs d’iPhone qui égarent régulièrement leurs affaires ou qui souhaitent ajouter une aide à la localisation peu coûteuse à leurs bagages. À ce prix, il est même envisageable d’en acheter plusieurs.
Mais attention, si vous utilisez un smartphone Android, alors vous ne pouvez pas utiliser l’AirTag 2. Dans ce cas, vous devez vous tourner vers une balise adaptée à votre terminal. Il faut aussi noter qu’Apple demande iOS 26.2.1 ou une version ultérieure afin d’utiliser cet accessoire.

articles.title: LibreOffice endurece regras para código gerado por IA no projeto
articles.text:
LibreOffice endurece regras para código gerado por IA no projeto
Uma das regras da The Document Foundation determina que o desenvolvedor seja capaz de explicar todo o código gerado com inteligência artificial.
Responsável pelo LibreOffice, a The Document Foundation (TDF) continua se mostrando reservada quanto ao uso de inteligência artificial no projeto. No movimento mais recente, a organização anunciou medidas para evitar que códigos gerados com IA sejam enviados ao LibreOffice de modo, digamos, irresponsável.
Na primeira olhada, parece que a TDF está indo contra uma tendência universal. A IA já está presente até no desenvolvimento do Linux, só para termos um exemplo.
Mas a organização não proíbe toda e qualquer contribuição para a sua suíte de escritório que tenha sido gerada com auxílio de IA. O objetivo de suas restrições é prevenir possíveis consequências oriundas do uso indiscriminado desse tipo de tecnologia.
Em linhas gerais, a TDF quer que os desenvolvedores que enviarem códigos ao LibreOffice sejam responsáveis por essas contribuições como se elas tivessem sido escritas totalmente por eles, de modo a favorecer aspectos como desempenho e segurança, presumivelmente.
A TDF anunciou cinco novas regras direcionadas ao uso de modelos de linguagem de larga escala (LLMs) no LibreOffice. São elas:
- autorização prévia: o desenvolvedor deve pedir permissão antes de usar um LLM em seu trabalho no LibreOffice;
- transparência de código: o uso de LLM deve sempre ser informado nos commits (registros das alterações feitas no código);
- compreensão do código gerado: o desenvolvedor precisa ser capaz de explicar todo o código produzido com auxílio de IA;
- restrição de IA em comunicações internas: LLMs não podem ser usados para mensagens de commit, comentários em código, relatórios de bugs ou comunicados a outras pessoas do projeto;
- restrições em partes do código: determinadas partes do código-fonte do LibreOffice não podem contar com contribuições geradas por LLMs.
As políticas de IA da TDF estão resumidas nesta página.
Apesar de haver alguma flexibilidade quanto ao uso de inteligência artificial nas entranhas do projeto, o pacote de escritório em si continua livre desse tipo de tecnologia do ponto de vista funcional. Nesse sentido, vale relembrar que o LibreOffice 26.8 foi lançado tendo a ausência de ferramentas de IA como um diferencial.

articles.title: Firefox 161 introduit 4 nouveautés qui vont transformer votre navigation
articles.text:
Firefox 161 est officiellement disponible. Et le moins que l’on puisse dire, c’est que les développeurs de Mozilla ne se sont pas tournés les pouces. Cette nouvelle mouture du navigateur introduit pas moins de quatre nouveautés qui devraient vous faire gagner un temps précieux et vous aider à protéger encore un peu plus la confidentialité de vos données pendant la navigation.
Des règles VPN individuelles par sites Web
La première grande nouveauté introduite par Firefox 161, c’est la possibilité de créer des règles VPN individuelles par sites. Cela signifie concrètement qu’il est désormais possible, sur la version desktop du navigateur, de définir si le VPN doit s’activer ou se désactiver automatiquement en fonction des sites que vous consultez.
Avec ce nouveau système de fonctionnement, vous n’aurez pas besoin de jongler avec l’activation ou la désactivation du VPN pour les sites sur lesquels vous l’utilisez habituellement.
Mozilla suggère que la fonction vous permettra aussi de faire quelques menues économies. En consultant un site marchand avec une IP d’une autre région, vous pourrez comparer plus facilement le prix de vos emplettes. À noter que la Fondation offre des données VPN illimitées dans Firefox jusqu’à la fin du mois de janvier 2027 si vous vous connectez avec un compte Mozilla.
La lecture vocale des articles arrive sur Android
Déjà présent sur la version desktop du navigateur, la lecture vocale des articles du Mode Lecture arrive enfin sur Android. La fonction vous permettra d’écouter le contenu d’un article ou d’une recette, plutôt que d’avoir à lire. L’interface du module offre un contrôle de la lecture et de la pause, avec la possibilité d’avancer ou de revenir en arrière dans la lecture, d’en ajuster la vitesse ou encore de choisir la voix.
Cerise sur le gâteau, la lecture vocale, dont le traitement est réalisé localement sur l’appareil pour préserver votre vie privée, fonctionne même écran éteint.
Un bouton Fire pour tout supprimer sur desktop
Jusqu’à maintenant réservé à la navigation privée, le bouton Fire débarque officiellement sur Desktop. Intégré directement à la fenêtre classique du navigateur, dans la barre d’outils, le bouton Fire permet d’effacer rapidement l’historique de navigation et de téléchargement, les cookies, les fichiers temporaires ainsi que les données de formulaires, le tout sans avoir à naviguer jusque dans les Paramètres du navigateur.
En un clic, vous pouvez effacer toutes traces de vos dernières recherches. Attention toutefois, la fonction vous laissera choisir entre une réinitialisation complète (qui ferme la fenêtre et vous déconnecte des sites), et la possibilité de choisir uniquement les données à supprimer tout en maintenant la fenêtre ouverte.
La fonction, dont le déploiement doit se faire de manière progressive, n’est pas nécessairement encore activée chez tous les utilisateurs sitôt la mise à jour installée. Si le bouton n’apparaît pas chez vous, rendez-vous sur la page about:config, cliquez que Accepter le risque et poursuivre, recherchez le paramètre browser.fireButton.enabled et changez sa valeur false par true.
Redémarrez ensuite le navigateur, vous devriez y trouver le bouton Fire greffé tout à droite de la barre d’outils.
Firefox se fait une place dans votre voiture
La quatrième et dernière grande nouveauté introduite par Firefox 161 est sa disponibilité sur le tableau de bord des véhicules équipés de Google intégré. Vous pouvez à présent vous rendre sur le Google Play Store pour y télécharger le navigateur dans votre véhicule. Sécurité oblige, l’utilisation de Firefox en voiture est restreinte. Vous ne pourrez l’utiliser qu’à l’arrêt, pratique pour tuer le temps pendant une recharge électrique ou une pause au cours d’un long trajet. Mozilla précise que les données de navigation ne sont jamais partagées avec le constructeur automobile, et qu’elle ne les conserve pas non plus.

articles.title: Ethereum: así cotiza este martes
articles.text:
Ethereum es una plataforma digital que adopta la tecnología de cadena de bloques (blockchain) y expande su uso a una gran variedad de aplicaciones, mientras que ether es su criptomoneda nativa. En el mundo de las finanzas digitales es común que la criptomoneda sea llamada como la red, aunque en realidad no son lo mismo.
La plataforma ethereum, creada en el 2015 por el programador Vitalik Buterin, buscaba ser un instrumento para aplicaciones descentralizadas y colaborativas sobre las que se pueden hacer contratos inteligentes (dAPPs)
Al igual que el bitcoin, el valor de ether se disparó en un corto periodo de tiempo. En enero de 2016, ether cotizaba alrededor de un dólar y actualmente tiene un máximo histórico de 4.953,73 dólares.
El costo de la criptomoneda de ethereum para este día a las 14:05 horas (UTC) es de 1700.26 dólares por unidad.
Esto quiere decir que la moneda digital reportó un cambio del -1.05 las últimas 24 horas, así como una variación del 0.0 % en la última hora.
Actualmente, ethereum se encuentra en el lugar #2 de popularidad en el mercado digital. Cabe mencionar que el máximo histórico que ha alcanzado esta divisa digital es de 4891.7 dólares por unidad.
Cotización de la criptomoneda Ethereum
La nueva era de Ether
Tras varios meses de retraso y con el temor de que ya nunca pasaría, finalmente el 15 de septiembre de 2022 Ethereum llevó a cabo su tan ansiada fusión o actualización al nuevo nivel 2.0 con la promesa de mejorar la experiencia de los usuarios de esta criptomoneda.
“The Merge”, inglés para “La Fusión”, es una transformación en la forma en que Ethereum procesa las transacciones y en cómo se crean nuevos tokens de Ether.
Esta fusión se trata de la combinación de la cadena de bloques de Ethereum con una nueva cadena de bloques separada conocido como proof-of-stake, el cual reduce el consumo de energía de la cadena de bloques de Ethereum en un 99,9 %, según sus propios desarrolladores, lo que la vuelve más “amigable” con el ambiente al tiempo que las transacciones serían más baratas.
Sus defensores creen que la fusión hará que Ethereum resulte favorecido con respecto al máximo rival, Bitcoin, pues podría aumentar su uso.
En el proceso Proof Stake los propietarios de Ether bloquearán cantidades establecidas de sus criptomonedas para verificar nuevos registros en la cadena de bloques, ganando nuevas monedas además de su criptografía “participada”.

articles.title: Europe forced Apple to open iPhone to rival browser engines, but Mozilla says the door is rigged
articles.text:
Walled Prison: On paper, Apple should now be required to give competing browsers and browser engines full access to the popular iOS ecosystem. But Mozilla says the iPhone maker is imposing so many restrictions on alternative browser engines that meaningful competition is unlikely to emerge anytime soon.
Thanks to Europe's Digital Markets Act, Apple has been required to improve browser choice on iOS in the Old Continent since 2024. Similar rules now apply in Japan as well. However, one of the few independent players in the browser market says Apple has no real intention of promoting competition on its tightly controlled mobile platforms.
In a recent blog post, Mozilla argued that, despite the new regulations, Apple's iOS ecosystem is still not truly "open" to competing browser engines. Alternative browsers such as Firefox are available on iOS, and millions of users have reportedly chosen them over Safari. However, one major limitation remains: these browsers are required to use WebKit, Apple's browser engine, which powers Safari and other third-party browsers on its platforms.
According to Mozilla, Apple is forcing browser developers to rebuild their products around WebKit. Consequently, third-party developers cannot easily bring their own distinctive features to Apple's mobile platforms because doing so requires their own browser engines, such as Mozilla's Gecko. These restrictions primarily affect iOS devices, including the iPhone and iPad, while other major operating systems – including Apple's own macOS – remain unaffected.
Apple has been compelled to improve browser choice on its mobile devices under the DMA, but the company has continued to push back against European regulatory requirements. Mozilla now claims that Cupertino is imposing its own set of conditions on developers seeking approval to bring competing browser engines to iOS. According to the foundation, these requirements are designed to make the process "as painful as possible."
Among these conditions is a restriction on disclosing non-public information related to the iOS version of Gecko. Even more problematic are Apple's browser update requirements. Mozilla says that simply installing a newer version of Firefox on an iOS device may not be possible under the current rules. Instead, Apple would apparently require Mozilla to release an entirely separate app, forcing Firefox users to transfer their data – including passwords, bookmarks, and browsing history – from the existing version to the new Gecko-based browser.
"The conditions Apple imposes, including a level of user friction Apple would never accept for its own apps, mean that the open door feels more like a trap door", Mozilla said.
Firefox users on iPhone have already demonstrated their willingness to choose alternatives to Safari, despite Apple's restrictions on the browser market. Mozilla would now like Cupertino to allow a genuinely open browser experience on iOS, including support for third-party browser engines such as Gecko.

articles.title: Microsoft’s historic cloud outage exposed an engineering “fog of war”
articles.text:
According to internal memos reviewed by Reuters, Microsoft has declared a “Code Red” overhaul of its engineering response practices after the November 12 outage that lost access to Exchange Online, Teams, and Outlook for users worldwide.
Per the memos, Microsoft 365 Core President Jason Henderson described the outage as having the most customer impact in the history of Exchange Online. In a separate memo, Henderson wrote that an urgent production fix in a recent incident took five to six days to reach worldwide saturation. Microsoft’s target for its most urgent security fixes is to move from detection to safe worldwide deployment in one hour. “Needless to say, we aren’t here yet,” Henderson wrote.
The memos, which Reuters reviewed but Microsoft has not published, outline the response to the November 12 disruption. The company’s post-incident report, dated November 20, attributed the downtime to an undetected Windows scalability defect introduced in July, which caused lock contention in the gateway processes. A Teams traffic failover then dumped additional load onto infrastructure already under stress, as maintenance had left nearly 14 percent of gateway server capacity offline at the time of the incident.

Driven by the rapid development of industrial automation, Edge AI, and smart devices, real-time data processing, system stability, and data security have become top priorities in embedded applications. articles.title: Cynoia launches Hannibal AI ahead of further African expansion
articles.text:
Cynoia launches Hannibal AI ahead of further African expansion
- Tunisian SaaS startup Cynoia has launched Hannibal AI, an AI-powered workplace assistant integrated into the latest version of its collaboration and work-management platform, alongside support for third-party AI tools, including ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor.
- Founded in 2019 by Nasreddine Riahi and Ayoub Rabeh, Cynoia provides a unified workspace for project management, task tracking, communication, video calls and file sharing. Its AI assistant analyses internal workspace data, generates reports and supports translation across nine languages, including several African languages.
- Since raising €850,000 in 2023 from investors including Digital Africa, Bpifrance, 216 Capital, Go Big Partners, KJ Holding and UGFS, Cynoia has grown its user base from 3,000 to more than 7,000, primarily in West Africa. The company employs 15 people across Tunisia, Senegal and France.
- In 2027, Cynoia plans to expand its partnerships with telecommunications operators across North and West Africa, strengthen its presence in Egypt, complete its international security and AI governance certifications, and raise a new funding round.
Press release:
Cynoia, whose team-collaboration platform counts more than 7,000 users, primarily in West Africa, rolled out version 3.1 of its work-management platform (projects, tasks, discussions, calls, notes and files) on November 12. The release embeds Hannibal AI, an AI assistant built in Africa for African teams, and opens the platform to leading third-party AI assistants.
A platform built for the realities of African teams
Cynoia serves more than 7,000 users, including teams at Yas Senegal, Expresso Senegal and MTN Côte d’Ivoire. Its user base is concentrated in West Africa (Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, Benin, Togo, Mali and Nigeria), with a growing presence in the DR Congo, Egypt, Tunisia and France. The platform, video calls included, is engineered to run on low bandwidth and is available on iOS and Android. Hannibal AI translates into French, English, Arabic, Wolof, Swahili, Hausa, Yoruba, Zulu and Spanish, and the app itself is available in six languages. Pricing is displayed in local currencies (CFA franc, Egyptian pound, naira, Kenyan shilling, dirham and more), and users can pay via mobile money with Wave or by bank card.
An assistant that works from your team’s own data
Hannibal AI answers natural-language questions drawing on the workspace’s projects, tasks, notes, calendar, discussions and files. Its responses come with tables, charts and direct links to the relevant tasks. It can also generate summaries, such as a progress update or the week’s plan.
Cynoia named its assistant after Hannibal, the Carthaginian general remembered for his strategic genius and for crossing the Alps where no one expected him. Carthage stood on what is now Tunisia, where Cynoia was founded. The ambition: to deliver intelligence born in Africa, in service of team strategy.
Open to market-leading AI tools, with data governance firmly under control
Through the open standard connector MCP (Model Context Protocol), third-party assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor can connect to a workspace, read its content and create tasks. Access requires explicit consent for each workspace. Every user can review and revoke their own connections, and workspace owners can suspend all of them at once.
Data is hosted on AWS and with local cloud providers such as Stellarix in Senegal. Cynoia has appointed a data protection officer with the CNIL in France, the CDP in Senegal and the INPDP in Tunisia, and its ISO 27001, ISO 42001 and SOC 2 certifications are in progress.
“A team doesn’t need an AI that writes for it; it needs an AI that knows where it stands,” says Nasreddine Riahi, co-founder and CEO of Cynoia. “A well-equipped team of five can now deliver what used to take fifteen. It’s a historic opportunity for African entrepreneurs, who have always had to do more with less.”
A trajectory on the rise
Since closing its €850,000 funding round in 2023, with backing from Digital Africa, Bpifrance, 216 Capital, Go Big Partners, KJ Holding and UGFS, among others, Cynoia opened its Dakar subsidiary in 2024, launched its iOS and Android apps in May 2026, and shipped Hannibal AI and the MCP connector in November 2026. Over that period, its user base grew from 3,000 to more than 7,000. The startup employs 15 people: 10 in Tunisia, 3 in Senegal and 2 in France. It was named best SaaS startup at AfricArena 2024, won the Provence Africa Connect award, and is a laureate of the TABC program in Senegal and the DRC.
Looking ahead to 2027
Cynoia already relies on distribution partners, including telecom operators and LafricaMobile in Senegal, under a revenue-sharing model. In 2027, the startup plans to forge new partnerships with telecom operators across North and West Africa, expand into new markets starting with Egypt, complete its ISO 27001, ISO 42001 and SOC 2 certifications, and raise a new funding round.

articles.title: Maharashtra GST Department conducts search at Turtlemint subsidiary
articles.text:
Maharashtra GST Department conducts search at Turtlemint subsidiary
The filing has added that the regular business operations of Turtlemint and TIB remains unaffected.
The Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax (GST) has initiated inspection,search and seizure proceedings at the premises of Turtlemint Insurance Broking Services, according to a regulatory filing on November 24.
The search was conducted at Turtlemint Insurance Broking Services Private Limited (“TIB”), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company at its registered office situated at Mumbai.
“TIB is extending full cooperation to the concerned authorities and is providing the requisite information, documents and clarifications as may be required in connection with the proceedings,” said the filing.
Turtlemint will keep the Stock Exchanges informed of further developments, if any, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
The filing has added that the regular business operations of Turtlemint and TIB remains unaffected. It also said that the company and TIB “remains commiƩed to conduct its business in compliance with the applicable laws and regulations.”
Founded in 2015 by Dhirendra Mahyavanshi and Anand Prabhudesai, Turtlemint operates an insurance distribution platform. It competes with companies such as Policybazaar and InsuranceDekho in India's digital insurance segment.

Nos 6 meilleurs vidéoprojecteurs en promo, du mini Full HD à 260 € au 4K tri-laser à 2 000 €
Quel vidéoprojecteur choisir pour le Black Friday ? Entre un Anker à 260 € pour regarder ses films dans une chambre, deux modèles sur batterie à emporter en week-end et trois projecteurs laser 4K pour le salon, voici les six offres que nous avons retenues.
Le Black Friday permet de mettre la main sur des TV à très bon prix, mais les vidéoprojecteurs profitent également de belles promos. Nous vous avons sélectionné les meilleurs modèles que nous avons testé ces derniers temps en fonction de votre budget, du petit modèle à moins de 300 € au puissant 4K trilaser à 2000 € en passant par les bons rapport qualité prix à moins de 1000 €.
Anker Nebula P1i à 260 € — Le bon plan pour les petits budgets
Vendu autour de 350 € au moment de notre test, le Nebula P1i passe à 260€ pour le Black Friday. C’est le moins cher de notre sélection et pourtant, il n’est pas en reste avec son image Full HD.
La bonne surprise vient de ses deux « oreilles », des haut-parleurs que l’on déplie et que l’on oriente vers les spectateurs. La stéréo est bien perceptible et on peut se passer d’enceinte d’appoint pour regarder un film. Anker Nebula P1i

Avec ses 1,4 kg, son pied métallique orientable et son petit chargeur USB-C, il prend peu de place dans une valise. Une fois arrivé, il suffit de le poser, d’incliner le pied vers le mur et de le laisser régler la mise au point et la géométrie de l’image. On retrouve ensuite les applications habituelles de Google TV.
Son image Full HD conserve une bonne netteté jusque près des bords, à condition de regarder ses films dans l’obscurité pour composer avec sa luminosité limitée. En bonus, il possède une batterie intégrée.
Dangbei Freedo

Très similaire au Dangbei Freedo, le MoGo 4 pèse 1,3 kg, profite lui aussi d’un pied orientable et de Google TV, et sa mini-télécommande s’attache directement au projecteur. À tarif égal, on privilégiera le Xgimi pour son design et les séances sur batterie avec sa meilleure autonomie, et le Freedo pour jouer, le retard à l’affichage du MoGo 4 grimpant à 61 ms.
XGIMI MoGo 4 (Led)

À 800 €, le Hisense M2 Pro est le modèle que nous conseillons à ceux qui regardent régulièrement des films sur grand écran. Sa source tri-laser lui permet de reproduire une palette de couleurs très étendue et, sur une image de 2 m de large, le gain de détail par rapport aux mini-projecteurs Full HD se voit facilement. Hisense a eu la bonne idée de conserver le pied orientable de la série C2 et d’y associer un zoom optique. On peut ainsi ajuster la taille de l’image sans déplacer le meuble qui accueille le projecteur. Le bon plan pour avoir une image 4K sans se ruiner.

articles.title: La ciencia llevaba años debatiendo si el cambio climático traería más o menos rayos. Una IA acaba de dar una respuesta inquietante
articles.text:
Durante más de una década, los expertos tenían en la mente la incógnita sobre si en un planeta cada vez más caliente sería más frecuente ver rayos caer contra la tierra. Hasta ahora, los distintos modelos climáticos que se han publicado apuntaban a conclusiones totalmente dispares, pero gracias al machine learning se ha visto que los rayos que impactan contra la superficie terrestre podrían aumentar entre un 76% y un 140% antes de que acabe el siglo.
Un debate científico. El trabajo más reciente que se ha publicado tiene bastante claro que el incremento medio que se viviría estaría cerca del 30% por cada grado centígrado de calentamiento global. Algo que puede ser muy espectacular, pero que lógicamente tendría impacto en los incendios forestales, la estabilidad de los bosques o las infraestructuras críticas.
Un debate. Para entender por qué este resultado es importante, conviene mirar atrás. En 2014, un estudio publicado en Science estimó que los rayos aumentarían alrededor de un 12 % por cada grado de calentamiento, lo que supondría un 50 % más de descargas hacia 2100. Aquel cálculo, sin embargo, se basaba en variables indirectas de energía convectiva y precipitación, y se limitaba únicamente al territorio continental de Estados Unidos.
Cuatro años después, en 2018, otra investigación llevó la discusión en sentido contrario. Al modelizar la microfísica del hielo en el interior de las nubes, concluyeron que la frecuencia global de rayos podría caer hasta un 15 % a finales de siglo. Entonces algo no terminaba de cuadrarnos.
Seis variables. Ahora la idea que se ha puesto encima de la mesa es que, en lugar de depender exclusivamente de fórmulas teóricas sobre cómo se electrifican las nubes, se entrenó a un modelo de aprendizaje automático con observaciones reales de rayos nube-tierra a escala global.
Para esto utilizaron FLASHMAP, un nuevo conjunto de datos desarrollado por los propios investigadores que registra descargas entre 2019 y 2024. Y la fiabilidad de esta base se contrastó previamente con redes regionales de detección en tierra de España, Alaska y Australia.
Lo que vieron. Al proyectar la relación aprendida por el algoritmo hacia finales de siglo, ambos modelos climáticos coinciden en una tendencia fuertemente alcista, aunque difieren en la magnitud exacta. En concreto, vemos que el incremento global de rayos nube-tierra sobre los continentes se sitúa entre el 76 % y el 140 %, lo que equivale a ese salto aproximado del 30 % por cada grado de aumento de la temperatura media.
No obstante, los propios autores apuntan que, mientras que en las latitudes medias y altas el comportamiento de ambos modelos climáticos es más consistente, la mayor diferencia aparece en las regiones tropicales al emplear uno de los dos modelos de referencia, con especial variabilidad sobre la Amazonía y Nueva Guinea. Algo que tiene sentido, puesto que los trópicos concentran buena parte de la actividad eléctrica del planeta.
Un problema. El interés de este grupo de investigación por los rayos no es meramente meteorológico, sino que quieren ver el efecto ecológico que pueden tener. Su conclusión es que ahora mismo los rayos "matan" cada año alrededor de 320 millones de árboles, con las consecuencias que puede tener.
Pero si la frecuencia de los rayos nube-tierra aumenta en estas proporciones, veríamos cómo los incendios son cada vez más frecuentes, sumado también a un ambiente mucho más seco.

articles.title: Exein launches Ray AI agent to show manufacturers which firmware weaknesses to fix first
articles.text:
Exein launches Ray AI agent to show manufacturers which firmware weaknesses to fix first
Italian physical artificial intelligence cybersecurity company Exein SpA today launched an AI agent called Ray that it claims can help manufacturers find the security weaknesses that matter most in their connected-device firmware.
Ray is built into Exein Analyzer, the company’s firmware security platform, which examines firmware for vulnerabilities, security weaknesses and compliance issues. Engineers can then use Ray to explore those findings in a conversational way, looking at the security posture of a single product or an entire fleet.
The new offering is designed to address a growing security gap for manufacturers. Some connected products contain thousands of software components, and a single scan of one can flag hundreds of potential issues, Exein said. Which of those weaknesses actually needs to be fixed first is said to be the harder question.
Rather than working through separate vulnerability lists, security scores, trackers and compliance reports, engineers can put questions to Ray about Analyzer’s findings. Among the questions engineers can ask are what is driving a product’s security score, which vulnerabilities need attention first and which compliance issues affect a firmware image.
To pick out the small number of issues that pose the greatest risk, Ray draws on Analyzer’s scan results, vulnerability reachability data and compliance findings. An explanation of why each issue matters is provided alongside the results. In cases where the same weakness appears across multiple products, Ray is said to help teams see when addressing one issue could improve security across an entire product line.
Exein is launching Ray after a run of attacks on connected infrastructure across Europe, including cyberattacks on supermarket refrigeration systems that disrupted stores in several countries in October and November. Similar risks extend to industrial equipment, healthcare, energy and transport systems, according to the company.
“Europe is connecting more of the physical world to software,” co-founder and Chief Technology Officer Giovanni Falcione said, “but too many products were never designed for the threat environment we have today. The recent attacks on refrigeration systems are a reminder that a weakness buried inside firmware can have consequences far beyond IT.”
The rate at which those weaknesses can be found and exploited is being “dramatically” accelerated by AI, Falcione said. With Ray, he said, engineering teams get a clearer way to work out what needs fixing before products reach the field, without every firmware engineer having to become a cybersecurity expert.
Also included in Ray is support for reading Analyzer’s findings against regulatory requirements such as the European Union’s Cyber Resilience Act. Reporting obligations under the act for actively exploited vulnerabilities and severe security incidents have applied since September, with the wider requirements taking effect in December 2027.
Founded in 2018, Exein offers technology that is distributed across more than 2 billion connected devices in sectors including industrial automation, automotive, energy, healthcare and robotics. The company’s other offerings include Photon, which provides runtime security for connected devices, physical AI and autonomous AI agents. It raised $270 million at a $1.7 billion valuation in September.

articles.title: Affaire des puces NVIDIA : Washington met sur liste noire sept sociétés soupçonnées d'alimenter la Chine
articles.text:
Le département du Commerce américain ajoute Megaspeed et six sociétés liées à l'Entity List. Toute livraison de produits soumis au contrôle des exportations américain exigera désormais une licence, que l’administration compte refuser par principe.
En juin 2025, NVIDIA avait inscrit Megaspeed sur sa liste interne d’entreprises à qui elle refuse de vendre. Le 23 novembre, le département du Commerce américain a rendu publique sa décision d’inscrire le groupe singapourien sur son Entity List, la liste noire commerciale américaine. La mesure coïncide avec le retour de Jensen Huang à la direction de NVIDIA, onze jours après l’annonce de sa démission.
Une licence pour les exportations de puces
Le Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), rattaché au département du Commerce, a inscrit sept sociétés sur l’Entity List. Le texte les répertorie sous Singapour, la Malaisie et la Thaïlande. Parmi elles figurent Megaspeed International Pte. Ltd., la filiale malaisienne Speedmatrix et Megaspeed (Thailand) mais aussi Apex Enterprise Solutions, filiale d’Alibaba. Le BIS invoque un risque important de détournement de matériel de calcul avancé vers des utilisateurs ou des usages non autorisés.
La mesure s’applique à tous les produits qui relèvent des Export Administration Regulations (EAR), la réglementation américaine sur les exportations. Lorsqu’une des sept sociétés intervient dans une exportation, une réexportation ou un transfert à l’intérieur d’un pays, ces produits sont soumis à licence. Le BIS examine les demandes avec une présomption de refus. Le texte prévoit une clause transitoire pour certaines expéditions qui étaient déjà en route.
Selon Reuters, Washington n’avait ajouté aucune société à l’Entity List depuis octobre 2025. L’agence avait rapporté en juin que l’administration Trump avait notamment différé l’inscription de DeepSeek, spécialiste de l’IA, et de CXMT, fabricant de puces mémoire, pour éviter d’attiser les tensions avec Pékin.
Washington enquête sur Megaspeed depuis 2024
Les autorités américaines cherchent à établir si Megaspeed a détourné des puces d’IA vers la Chine. L’entreprise affirme respecter les contrôles à l’exportation. Le 24 novembre, le Premier ministre de Singapour, Lawrence Wong, a confirmé que son pays poursuivait sa propre enquête pour déterminer si Megaspeed avait enfreint le droit singapourien.
L’affaire a pris un tour politique avec la révélation de la liaison de Jensen Huang avec Alice Huang, ancienne dirigeante de Megaspeed qui, selon l’entreprise, a quitté ses fonctions en août 2025.
D’après le New York Times, les services américains soupçonnent Alice Huang d’avoir transmis des renseignements à Pékin. Les autorités chinoises contestent toutefois cette accusation. Selon Lawrence Wong, les investigations singapouriennes n’ont pas permis de poursuivre Alice Huang. Celles-ci portaient sur de possibles fausses déclarations liées à des achats de serveurs, et non sur l’espionnage, précise d’ailleurs le ministère de l’Intérieur singapourien.
Le 13 novembre, le secrétaire américain au Trésor Scott Bessent avait publiquement reproché au département du Commerce de tarder à inscrire Megaspeed sur la liste. Il s’était aussi interrogé sur les vérifications menées par NVIDIA auprès de son client. Le fabricant a depuis annoncé la création d’un comité de son conseil d’administration chargé de superviser le respect des contrôles à l’exportation et les risques liés à la sécurité nationale.
Pour les puces fabriquées à l’étranger, les autres contrôles comptent aussi
L’inscription de Megaspeed sur la liste noire soulève toutefois un débat sur les puces fabriquées hors des États-Unis. La Foreign Direct Product Rule (FDPR) permet à Washington de contrôler certains produits fabriqués à l’étranger à l’aide de technologies ou de logiciels américains. Mais la décision ne comporte pas la mention qui aurait étendu spécifiquement ce dispositif aux entreprises visées.
Pour Chris McGuire, ancien responsable des politiques technologiques à la Maison-Blanche, cette absence réduit fortement l’efficacité de la mesure. Le BIS conteste cette lecture : selon lui, les règles existantes permettent déjà de contrôler les ventes de puces d’IA avancées fabriquées à l’étranger.
Ces règles ont notamment été renforcées le 19 novembre, avec une obligation de licence pour certaines livraisons de puces avancées vers Singapour, la Malaisie et la Thaïlande. L’inscription de Megaspeed à cette liste noire vient donc s’ajouter à des restrictions déjà en place. Quelques jours après les sourires du sommet de Shenzhen, Washington resserre un peu plus ses contrôles sur les puces d’IA susceptibles de finir en Chine.
Source : Computerbase

articles.title: VP do Google: pessoas não querem apenas IA na busca
articles.text:
VP do Google: pessoas não querem apenas IA na busca
Elizabeth Reid, chefe da Busca do Google, afirma que usuários ainda querem conteúdo produzido por pessoas.
As pessoas não querem uma experiência de busca “puramente de IA”, segundo Elizabeth Reid, vice-presidente de busca do Google. Para a executiva, os usuários ainda procuram opiniões, experiências pessoais, comunidades e conteúdos aprofundados produzidos por pessoas.
Reid afirmou que o caminho para a busca seria combinar os dois formatos: “o melhor da web e o melhor da IA”. A declaração foi dada ao podcast FOMO Sapiens.
Na avaliação de Reid, parte das páginas encontradas hoje na internet pode ser substituída facilmente por uma resposta de chatbots de inteligência artificial. Ela usa como exemplo uma página criada apenas para informar o fuso horário do Japão. Nesse tipo de consulta, o usuário estaria interessado na resposta, e não necessariamente no site. Cabe notar que, hoje em dia, o próprio Google já dá a resposta no começo página de busca.
Mas as pessoas ainda valorizam bastante a opinião e a especialização dos sites, diz Reid. Ela menciona moda como exemplo: uma pessoa que já acompanhava blogs ou influenciadores para descobrir tendências provavelmente não deixaria de buscar essas fontes apenas porque um chatbot consegue responder quais roupas combinam entre si.
Segundo a executiva, ainda existe demanda por conteúdos que tragam experiência pessoa, pontos de vista próprios e pesquisa aprofundada. “O que geralmente vemos é que as pessoas não querem puramente IA, elas querem IA e a web”, afirmou Reid.
A defesa de uma experiência que continue valorizando a web aparece, porém, em um momento no qual os Resumos de IA do próprio Google vêm mudando a distribuição de tráfego para sites. Os resumos aparecem antes dos resultados tradicionais em determinadas pesquisas e podem responder parte da dúvida sem que o usuário abra uma das fontes.
O impacto já chegou a alguns dos maiores sites da internet, como o Reddit, que perdeu 13% da audiência em um ano, segundo levantamento recente. No mesmo período, a empresa afirmou aos acionistas que o número de acessos únicos cresceu 16%.
O fórum decidiu, no ano passado, bloquear robôs do Internet Archive para evitar a raspagem de dados por empresas de IA, e, mais recentemente, passou a exigir login para acessar as páginas dentro do fórum.
A plataforma está entre as fontes amplamente utilizadas por sistemas de IA generativa, assim como redes sociais e a Wikipédia. A enciclopédia digital também registrou queda de acessos com a capacidade das IAs generativas responderem diretamente perguntas sobre assuntos que antes levavam o público ao site.
A redução de cliques não está restrita a grandes plataformas. Sites que dependem de textos publicados na internet vêm relatando perda de audiência desde a expansão das respostas de IA nas buscas.
No Brasil, veículos e associações de imprensa denunciaram ao Conselho Administrativo de Defesa Econômica (Cade) que as novas ferramentas do Google têm afetado inclusive o rendimento com anúncios, já que o usuário passou a não sair mais da página inicial da plataforma. Alguns veículos pedem que a empresa seja obrigada a pagar pelo conteúdo usado no treinamento e nas respostas das IAs, como ocorre na Austrália.
O órgão transformou o inquérito em investigação formal neste ano e apura se o Google realmente abusa da posição dominante no mercado de notícias. A empresa nega, dizendo que o tráfego tem sido afetado, na verdade, pelas redes sociais e apps de vídeos curtos, como o TikTok.

articles.title: Fintech startup Vegapay to raise Rs 38.4 Cr in Series A funding round led by Prosus
articles.text:
Fintech startup Vegapay to raise Rs 38.4 Cr in Series A funding round led by Prosus
The round will also see participation from existing investors Elevation Capital, Vertex Ventures and Eximius Ventures.
Vegapay, the Mumbai-headquartered digital lending and card management platform, will be raising Rs 38.4 crore in a Series A round of funding led by Prosus.
The regulatory filings of Vegapay reveal that this round will also see participation from existing investors, Elevation Capital, Vertex Ventures and Eximius Ventures.
Entrackr reported this development earlier.
A special resolution has been passed by Vegapay to issue 18,090 compulsory convertible preference shares (CCPS) at a price of Rs 21,221.92 per share, which leads to a total fundraise of Rs 38.4 crore.
Prosus will invest Rs 28.80 crore through its investment firm MIH Investments One BV. Elevation Capital will invest Rs 6.04 crore, and Vertex Ventures Rs 2.30 crore. Eximius will infuse Rs 1.25 crore.
Prior to this, Vegapay had raised Rs 37.9 crore in a pre-Series A round of funding led by Vertex Ventures. The round also saw participation from Elevation Capital and Eximius Ventures.
Founded by Gaurav Mittal, Himanshu Agrawal, Puneet Sharma, and Abhinav Garg in 2022, Vegapay is building a lending tech stack and a card management system that enables regulated entities and fintech firms to issue and increase penetration of card and lending in India.
The company offers a flexible pay-as-you-go model, reducing financial barriers. Flexibility, scalability, and speed are the platform's key differentiators, says Vegapay,
Prosus has become an active investor in the fintech segment of the Indian startup ecosystem. It has invested $100 million in Sachin Bansal-led Navi and $10 million in Bachatt.
Edited by Swetha Kannan

articles.title: Mandats d’arrêt, personnes disparues, casiers… des hackers ont piraté la base de données du FBI
articles.text:
Le FBI a détecté une intrusion dans le National Crime Information Center (NCIC), sa base de données nationale d’informations criminelles. Géré par le FBI depuis 1967, ce gigantesque fichier informatique est exploité par toutes les polices du pays, dont le FBI et les autres agences fédérales, la police de chaque État, et les polices locales comme les shérifs ou les polices municipales.
À lire aussi : Piratage de frigos de supermarchés – une opération secrète a évité une catastrophe au Royaume-Uni
Une base de données très sensible
On y trouve les personnes recherchées et les mandats d’arrêt, les personnes disparues, dont des enfants, les antécédents judiciaires, les ordonnances de protection, ainsi que les véhicules et les armes volés. En 2025, la base comptait plus de 19,3 millions de fiches, selon Malwarebytes. Dans la foulée, le ministère de l’Agriculture a également été compromis. Le système de paiement des agriculteurs a été visé par des pirates, et s’est retrouvé momentanément hors service.
Interrogée par Axios, Cynthia Kaiser, ancienne responsable de la division cyber du FBI, estime qu’il est « important de prendre cela au sérieux ». Un autre ancien cadre du FBI, contacté par CNN, ne s’inquiète « pas seulement de savoir si les pirates ont eu accès à des informations sensibles, même si c’est un problème, mais s’ils ont pu compromettre l’exactitude des informations sur lesquelles s’appuient les agents ». Concrètement, un pirate pourrait modifier ou effacer une fiche, ce qui pourrait permettre à des individus d’échapper à un contrôle de police.
Donald Trump y voit « un aspect positif »
À la surprise générale, Donald Trump a réagi en assurant que le piratage du FBI avait peut-être des bons côtés. Évoquant l’enquête du FBI sur l’ingérence russe dans la présidentielle de 2016, l’actuel président espère que la cyberattaque s’accompagnera de la divulgation d’informations confidentielles. L’enquête devait déterminer si la Russie avait cherché à influencer l’élection présidentielle américaine, et si l’équipe de campagne de Donald Trump avait des liens avec Moscou. Trump n’a jamais digéré cette enquête, et ne cesse d’y revenir en assurant qu’il s’agit d’un canular.
« Mais peut-être apprendrons-nous des choses que nous n’aurions jamais apprises autrement, parce que, vous savez, il y a eu le canular Russie, Russie, Russie », déclare Donald Trump.
Le républicain a aussi estimé que c’était l’occasion d’en apprendre plus « sur la fraude électorale, toute la fraude électorale qui a eu lieu ». Il s’est défendu en prétendant vouloir toujours « voir les choses de manière positive ». Pour le moment, personne ne sait qui est derrière la cyberattaque. Le FBI n’a pointé du doigt aucun suspect. Rien ne relie actuellement cette intrusion à ShinyHunters, le gang de cybercriminels qui a piraté le portail de recrutement du FBI, il y a quelques mois.
À lire aussi : Cyberattaque contre la Commission européenne – des données personnelles ont été volées, des hackers chinois sont suspectés
Une cyberdéfense affaiblie
La cyberattaque survient dans le cadre d’une explosion des incidents de sécurité aux États-Unis… et d’une réduction massive des effectifs consacrés à la cybersécurité depuis le retour de Donald Trump au pouvoir. L’agence fédérale de cybersécurité a été obligée de se séparer de près de 1 000 employés depuis l’arrivée de la nouvelle administration. C’est aussi le cas du FBI.
« Quand on ajoute des adversaires de plus en plus sophistiqués à des infrastructures vieillissantes, la vraie question n’est pas seulement d’empêcher les attaques, mais de s’assurer que les services publics essentiels puissent résister aux perturbations », avertit Chris Grove, de Nozomi Networks.
